title: Study of the Interprofessional Reproducibility of a Clinical Observation Scale for the Development of Very Premature Infants
official: Study of the Interprofessional Reproducibility of a Clinical Observation Scale for the Development of Very Premature Infants Aged 1 to 6 Months Corrected, for the Very Early Detection of Developmental Disorders.
summary: The research concerns the study of the interprofessional reproducibility of a grid for observing the development of premature infants from 1 to 6 months corrected age. No tool is available to characterize the mechanisms of early developmental processes and their deviations. We propose an analytical observation grid of developmental mechanisms in the first few months, in order to identify warning signs of developmental deviations and help define the nature and type of early care for vulnerable infants.

interventions.name: SPIN-NA Developmental Observation Grid Assessment via Home-Based Standardized Video Recording
